scope: Read-only audit of CURRENT dirty tree. Dedicated bust-revealed tower route / T4 prioritized; production and tests unchanged.
method: Actual imported runtime + seeded presets in Node; main.js integration and authored plan statically traced. This is not a browser playthrough.

sharedPrelude.observation: Current unravelling has a broad fixed walkable floor and tickHorizon does not reset the body. Bell-noise resets belong to the separate route AFTER accepting the bust.

references.reason: tickHorizon advances decay without returning a body reset

dedicatedRoute.current: Accept qualified bust proposition -> revealed sideways path -> bells/service-door field -> two hidden key doors unlock belfry -> actual tower/finale. Optional lock-in door -> forward walk -> school-hall stub -> its exit returns straight to road.
dedicatedRoute.intendedT4: Lock-in -> snowed hall/boy -> tape field -> dead broadcast/mast -> ash building/last recordist -> second hall/handover/collapse -> original road. Ordered bell errand; playable take, ending flag, combat advantage.

afterReleasedWorldFolds.note: main.syncStationErrand calls putBackWrong when this released crossing becomes null, even while towerLand stays active. Components dynamically verified; main integration statically traced.

open.line: There’s no handle on this side.

findings.title: Lock-in hall is outside the current floor and is immediately clamped 190.1m away
findings.effect: Entry localY -3462 is above BELLS.from -3842; all four attempted steps are walls. The next ordinary bell-field tick moves localY to -3842.2 while hall-only props remain active.
findings.evidenceStrength: Dynamic runtime reproduction plus ordinary main loop trace

refs.reason: bell step not guarded for active land

findings.recommendation: Author lands relative to current route bounds and give their floor/collision/tick ownership an explicit active-land branch.

findings.title: A seed can assign the sole lock-in to a barred door
findings.effect: Seed31 source-tower-door-11 is lockIn=true and shut=true; openDoorFieldDoor returns outskirt-door-shut. The only T4 entrance is unreachable in that seed.
findings.evidenceStrength: Dynamic bounded seed scan (1 failure in seeds1–250) and actual open attempt

refs.reason: key/openable fallback can select any non-key piece
later world coverage pass does not guarantee selected lock-in is unbarred

findings.recommendation: Choose the lock-in after the final openable deal or explicitly guarantee that chosen non-key door opens.

findings.title: Hall identity and its return point disappear on reload after entrance consumption is saved
findings.effect: Active hall is closure state; main return point is transient stationWay.lockInFrom. Snapshot omits both, while lockIn.seen/consumed crossing are persisted. Restored runtime has no active hall and the original hall entry has no floor.
findings.evidenceStrength: Focused real-runtime serialize/recreate reproduction; main save/return wiring traced

refs.reason: entrance marked seen before hall entry
resume restores saved position without active land

findings.recommendation: Save active land, stage/progress, and exact road return pose together with entrance consumption; repair already stranded saves.

findings.kind: integration defect with dynamic component proof
findings.title: A wrong-return lock-in can teleport the player out of the hall when its old world folds
findings.effect: Seed4417 lock-in is wrong=true. finishLockIn releases crossing then enters hall. After .7s crossing=null; syncStationErrand still calls putBackWrong from its old crossing, relocating to road while towerLand remains active.
findings.evidenceStrength: Seed/crossing/fold/return spot dynamically reproduced; main call order statically traced, not browser-executed

refs.reason: wrong return applies to ended lock-in too
relocation does not clear land state

findings.recommendation: Consume the previous crossing return action on entry to a persistent land, or prohibit wrong-return semantics for that entrance.

findings.kind: authored planned behavior missing, not a proven regression
findings.title: T4 journey stops at an inspection-only hall and its door immediately returns to road
findings.effect: Only school-hall exists as a walkable land. The boy is a static shadow prop; land-piece only inspects; land-door calls leaveTowerLandNow. No tape/broadcast/ash/second-hall progression occurs.
findings.evidenceStrength: Closed land registry and interaction dispatch traced; plan explicitly remains unchecked

refs.reason: the worlds do exist as crossing visual/bed variants

findings.recommendation: Design/implement the finite state route and narrative verbs before adding more staging or palette work.

findings.kind: authored planned behavior missing, not a proven regression
findings.title: Ordered bell errand and promised recordist rewards have no connected runtime owner
findings.effect: Key-door takebacks only play a remote toll/unlock cue. Physical bell strikes increment noise and can reset; no order comparison, recordist tape grant, ending quote flag, or T4 combat advantage is wired to a land event.
findings.evidenceStrength: Bounded production/search inspection of land dispatch, station snapshot/reducer, key-answer callback, bell field, finale entry, and Source narrative; not a claim that unrelated tapes/recordists do not exist elsewhere

refs.reason: station schema carries no T4 objective/reward state

findings.recommendation: Give T4 one saved objective/reward contract and wire order recognition, replayable take, ending consequence, and combat initialization to its completion.

findings.title: Hall swaps props but keeps the bell-field environment and observer-centred light
findings.effect: Tower-land branch exists for propInstances only. sourceAmbient stays BELLS_AMBIENT, localLights returns source-void-lamp centred on player; stage lamp metadata is only emissive. Main still selects corridor rain/elsewhere crossing beds; released crossing folds away. Static snow drifts exist, but no active hall snow/weather/bed ownership.
findings.evidenceStrength: Dynamic ambient/light/weather values plus traced renderer/audio inputs

refs.reason: no light submission from land props
snowed hall and warm stage promised in inspection text

findings.recommendation: Give each real land its own weather, ambient/local fixture lights, sound bed, and saved environment lifecycle; reuse the actual world-variant identity.

tests.coverageGap: No bounded suite traverses enterTowerLand -> tickBellField -> save/reload -> land exit, seed31 barred lock-in, or the planned T4 story/rewards. Green station tests prove ordinary crossing persistence, not T4 completion.

queries: ordered bell / bell order / ring order
searchScope.limitation: Absence conclusions are scoped to connected Source land/station/finale owners and explicit T4 plan. Existing unrelated recordist art, recordings, combat dialogue, and elsewhere visual variants were not counted as T4 implementation.
